title: Ideal Nashville Base Near Downtown & Hospitals
description:
A modern industrial Nashville condo designed for 30+ day stays. Ideal for traveling professionals, relocations, and extended visits. Features a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed WiFi, dedicated workspace, Smart TV, and in-unit laundry for everyday convenience. Enjoy a clean, quiet, pet-friendly space with easy access to downtown, hospitals, the airport (7 min) and major employers—comfortable, reliable, and ready to feel like home.

Book or contact us now with any questions that you have!

The space
What you’ll love:

• Smart TV with Roku — unwind after long shifts
• Hotel-style linens — professionally cleaned for a restful sleep
• High-speed WiFi — reliable for remote work, charting, and streaming
• Dedicated workspace — desk + chair for productivity
• Fully equipped kitchen — cook meals easily and save on dining out
• In-unit washer & dryer — perfect for weekly routines and longer stays
• Keurig coffee maker — quick coffee before early mornings
• Amazon Alexa — hands-free music, alarms, and daily updates

Designed for extended stays:
• Ideal for travel nurses, corporate housing, and relocations
• Pet-friendly — bring your companion along
• Clean, quiet, and organized for day-to-day living
• Comfortable setup for both work and relaxation

Location highlights — close to everything you need, while still offering a peaceful place to recharge:
• ~9 mins to Downtown / Broadway
• ~8 mins to Nashville International Airport (BNA)
• ~10 mins to grocery stores, gyms, and daily essentials
• Easy access to I-24, I-40, and I-65 for commuting

---

Getting Around (Hospitals & Medical Centers)

This location is ideal for travel nurses and medical professionals, with quick access to many of Nashville’s major hospitals:

• ~5–10 mins to TriStar Southern Hills Medical Center
• ~10–12 mins to Vanderbilt University Medical Center
• ~10–12 mins to TriStar Centennial Medical Center
• ~10 mins to Ascension Saint Thomas Midtown
• ~12–15 mins to Ascension Saint Thomas West
• ~10 mins to Nashville General Hospital
• ~15 mins to TriStar Skyline Medical Center

Most major hospitals in Nashville are within roughly **2–7 miles of downtown**, making this location highly convenient for commuting healthcare professionals.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire space.

Other things to note
Everything Nashville has to offer is in close proximity to the apartment. 

📍West End - 12mins
📍Broadway/Bridgestone Arena - 9mins 
📍12 South - 10mins
📍East Nashville - 12mins
📍Airport (BNA) - 8mins
📍Nissan Stadium - 8mins
📍Nashville Zoo - 10mins
📍Grand Ole Opry - 15mins
📍First Tennessee Park - 10mins

There is a rental agreement that needs to be signed after each booking is confirmed. It will be sent over immediately after booking and can be signed digitally.
